title: Focus on the Capturing Group
text: Because the regex uses parentheses around [A-Z!]+, re.findall returns only the text captured inside that group, not the entire matched substring.

title: Interpret [A-Z!]+
text: The character class [A-Z!] matches one uppercase letter or an exclamation mark. The + means the group captures one or more of those characters in a row.

title: Captured Portion of CUT3
text: In the substring CUT3, what part is captured by the group ([A-Z!]+) before the extra $$[**\.]$$ character is matched?

title: Account for the Character Outside the Group
text: The $$[**\.]$$ part must match one additional character that is not a period. Since this part is outside the parentheses, that extra character is required for a match but is not returned by re.findall.

title: Eliminate Extra Characters
text: Reject answer choices that include characters outside the capturing group, such as the $$3$$ in CUT3 or the space represented by \_ in WORST\_. Among the choices, keep only strings that exactly match captured outputs from re.findall
